author: Sylvestreetlucie
comment: Ideal location but management of the residence to review completely.1- the evening of our arrival, the person contacted on the phone gave us the wrong code of the safe to collect the keys outside the residence. The given code had only the first 4 digits while the actual code had about ten. If a girl concerned too had not given us her code we would have spent the night outside with our 3 young children2- a wall lamp from the children’s room was unhooked and the electric wires accessible to little fingers .., I had to put tape to prevent them from electrocuting. 3- the flusher no longer had a button so to flush we had to remove the tank cover. => reported on the 1st and day a speaker had to pass but never came at the time said4- the ski room had no light (bulbs HS) despite raising all tenants => no repairs throughout the week5- exposed electrical wires also on the heating of a bathroom6- no shower side light in a bathroom => Forced to shower in the dark...7- roller shutter of the children's room did not work. Locked in the closed position despite the mountain view... behind. Anyway. Luckily we spend the majority of our time outside.

author: Tibo V
comment: Dirty apartment, poorly equipped rooms. The pictures do not match what you get. Dirty oven, dirty cutlery, dirty terrace, we still had to clean everything before we could start our holiday and much more.We just had a nice view...

author: Pieter
comment: The location of the apartment is excellent, right opposite the ski lift.There is only someone present at the reception after 1600, even on changeover days. The apartment is spacious, but not clean with some overdue maintenance. Many small things are not repaired. Curtains that cannot be opened/closed, skirting boards that are missing, the sink that is loose in the worktop, no schiffons/odor traps in the showers, a shower without a screen or curtain and the list goes on.Three bathrooms, ultimately with 1 usable shower, a bathroom with a shower in the bath where a 1.75 person cannot stand upright, a shower without a screen or curtain where showering makes everything in the bathroom wet (without an odor trap) and one that is usable (also without an odor trap but with a hand full of hair from previous residents)Cleaning is one thing, there is a lot of dust and rubbish under the furniture and beds. For the amount paid in high season, you can expect your apartment to be at least clean.Bring a rod with a shower curtain.

author: Durby P
comment: Apartment location excellent.The apartment itself was very disappointing.Not clean and many things broken.Lots of dust on the floors and under the beds.Few cooking utensils and decent pans.Clogged sinksFoul smell from toilet and shower.

author: Durby P
comment: An apartment with everything wrong.Toilet roll holder was hanging out of the wall with several holes around it.Toilet smelled and was not clean.Coffee filter from previous guests was still in the machine.Lots of dust. This also applies under the beds. Bathroom filters full of dustMinimal cutlery. Not good cooking. Poor kitchen lighting.Sink drained poorly. Water remained standing.Shower downstairs had a strong sewage smell with lots of hair in the drain.Showering there was almost impossible. No shower cabin or wall, so the entire bathroom became soaking wet.Kitchen curtain broken, half hanging there.
